name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 2: Hestrafors IF - IK Omega
description: Hestrafors IF to IK Omega. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Borås, Bollebygd and OSM relation tags use 10 km, while Naturkartan says 9.3 km and the official GPX computes to about 9.304 km.

Official text says the stage starts at Hestrafors IF in Brandshed with parking/information at the clubhouse, but Naturkartan/OSM route geometry starts about 392 m south of the converted Hestrafors IF coordinate.

Official route endpoint is IK Omega and GPX/OSM/Borås IK Omega coordinates align. However, Borås also lists a separate Start etapp 3 coordinate about 1.14 km south, and Olsfors/Omegastugan pages describe practical parking/transit access there.
OSM relation 5604822 has from=Brandshed and to=IK Omega, but its member order is east-to-west.
Bollebygd/Västsverige text still says the shelter is under restoration, while Västkuststiftelsen's 2024 report and a March 2025 Vindskyddskartan note suggest a new shelter exists.

OSM/map-symbol evidence supports a toilet at Abborrsjön, but AllTrails 2025 reports conflict between no bathrooms and bathrooms available. Hestrafors IF and Omegastugan club facilities are not confirmed as public hiker toilets.
